        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

class Solution:
    def maxPathSum(self, root: TreeNode) -> int:
        def max_gain(node):
            if not node:
                return 0
            # max path sum going through the left child
            left_gain = max(max_gain(node.left), 0)
            # max path sum going through the right child
            right_gain = max(max_gain(node.right), 0)
            # update the global max path sum
            self.max_sum = max(self.max_sum, node.val + left_gain + right_gain)
            # return the max path sum going through the current node
            return node.val + max(left_gain, right_gain)

        self.max_sum = float('-inf')
        max_gain(root)
        return self.max_sum

def get_words(hash_of_letters):

    for letter, count in hash_of_letters.items():

    filtered_permutations = [perm for perm in all_permutations if sorted(perm) == sorted(letters)]
